search_invariant: Foundation uses the registered width-64 seven-digit beam. ASCENT uses the same beam and latent probability gate, plus a query-matched digit prefix reconstructed only by passing the charged latent state through the frozen suffix. Raw source token IDs, source text, and target answers are unavailable to the evidence decoder. If no valid prefix is reconstructed, ASCENT falls back to its unconstrained numeric beam.
primary_metric: NVIDIA RULER string_match_all under ASCENT latent-evidence plus matched numeric generation
development_gate: ASCENT's paired official-score point estimate must be positive at every endpoint and strictly increase across both adjacent scale transitions. A favorable curve requires three newly generated untouched confirmation seeds with positive adjacent cluster intervals and a positive seed-clustered log-parameter slope interval.
interpretation: This is the proposal's dual path: latent replay supplies a neural evidence channel as well as a generative probability channel. The evidence prefix is decoded from model-width latent state, not retained raw text. The protocol is still a 192-token query plus external state, not a full-context leaderboard score. FPVM excluded.
